title: Service
description: One third-party service: how to recognise it on a page, what it stores in the browser, and who receives the data. Every file in services/ must validate against this schema.

id.description: Permanent. Never renamed or deleted: sites store it. A renamed service gets a new id, and the old file gets replacedBy.

version.description: Raised by one on every change to the file, so sites using the service can show what changed.

name.description: The product name, as the vendor writes it. Never translated.

provider.description: The legal entity that receives the data, for visitors in the EU where it differs. Empty when it could not be confirmed.

category.description: essential: the site cannot work without it. functional: a feature the visitor uses (chat, forms, spam protection). statistics: measuring visits. marketing: advertising and cross-site tracking. media: embedded videos, maps and posts.

purpose.description: One short, plain sentence for visitors, ending with a full stop.

privacyUrl.description: The vendor's privacy policy. Empty when it could not be confirmed.

dataCountry.description: Where the data is processed or stored, as the vendor states it. Write USA for the United States, and name the EU-US Data Privacy Framework only when the vendor is listed on dataprivacyframework.gov. Empty when it could not be confirmed.

legalBasis.description: The basis a site usually relies on. Anything that is not strictly necessary is consent.

match.description: How the service is recognised. A URL matches a host pattern when its host equals the pattern's host or is a subdomain of it, and its path and query start with the pattern's rest. The longest matching pattern across all services wins. Empty only for a service known by its cookies alone.

inline.description: Substrings that identify the service's code written into the page.

name.description: A trailing * matches any suffix. A / is allowed: some services name cookies like paths. Never translated.

purpose.description: A few plain words, ending with a full stop.

httpOnly.description: Set by the server and unreadable by scripts, so a site cannot remove it from the browser.

storage.description: localStorage and sessionStorage keys; a trailing * matches any suffix.

google.description: A Google tag that reads Google Consent Mode.

advanced.description: Can send cookieless pings before consent, if the site owner allows it (Consent Mode's advanced setup).

placeholder.description: What to show in place of an embed that waits for consent. null for services that show nothing on the page.

wordpress.description: Hints about other WordPress plugins. Data only.

plugins.description: Plugins that usually add this service, as folder/main-file.php.

handles.description: Script handles registered by another plugin that only work together with this service, so they wait for consent with it.

sources.description: The vendor's own pages the facts were checked against.

checked.description: The day a person last checked the facts against the sources.

replacedBy.description: The id that took over this service after a rename or merger.

retired.description: The service no longer exists. The file stays so sites that use it keep working.
